guidance.title: Choose and record a snapshot
guidance.text: Use the yuntian-deng repositories linked here for current downloads and access requests. For comparisons with earlier studies, match their collection window, revision, and filters. Release names are not current row counts.

guidance.title: Request Full access in the current repository
guidance.text: Submit an access request on yuntian-deng/WildChat-4.8M-Full with a detailed explanation of why your work needs flagged content. Approval is reviewed manually.

guidance.title: Keep evaluation data separate
guidance.text: The processing pipeline removes conversations reserved for WildBench. Preserve that separation when constructing training sets or comparing with the benchmark.

guidance.title: Distinguish logs from synthetic extensions
guidance.text: WildChat-50M is a separate follow-up by Benjamin Feuer and Chinmay Hegde: it adds responses from more than 50 open-weight models to WildChat prompts. Its name does not mean 50 million newly collected human conversations.

guidance.title: Use the appropriate citation
guidance.text: Cite Zhao, Ren, Hessel, Cardie, Choi, and Deng’s ICLR 2024 WildChat paper for the dataset. Cite the separate WildVis paper when using the visualizer, and identify the downloaded release and revision.

guidance.title: Check terms and removal instructions
guidance.text: The Full release card lists ODC-BY and explains how to request removal using conversation hashes or turn identifiers and the contact details on Yuntian Deng’s homepage.

guidance.title: Interpret metadata carefully
guidance.text: The paper describes geographic data inferred from IP addresses and discusses selection bias in the service’s user population. Treat this as a particular population of chatbot users when interpreting aggregate behavior.

guidance.title: Understand the identifiers
guidance.text: In the expanded releases, conversation_hash identifies content and is not a unique conversation key. The cards identify turn_identifier as the unique identifier within each turn.
